role: solar <-> lunar date conversion on the Korean lunisolar calendar (KASI almanac), leap month marked
rules: answer and source are required, as in every contract; the structured fields are optional (an outside member may answer in text; the normalizer reads both), and our own substitute fills them all
solar_date and lunar_date are both YYYY-MM-DD; a lunar date in a leap month has is_leap_month true

the Korean calendar (KASI) is the reference; calendar_basis is "korean_kasi" or "chinese"; a Chinese-calendar member says "chinese", and a date that differs from the Korean calendar is scored wrong, not hidden
calendar=lunar converts the lunar input to solar first (is_leap_month picks the leap month)
read-only calculation; no account, payment or write; the birth date is used for the calculation only and never stored or logged
